texts:
Saturday's notes, team by team: three big names ruled out, four players off IR and Philadelphia's Monday night report.

Lamar Jackson

DeVonta Smith

Jordan Mason
#RavensFlock #FlyEaglesFly #Skol

Baltimore ruled Lamar Jackson out Sunday with the high ankle sprain, his third straight missed game. Tyler Huntley starts again.

Pivot to Bo Nix, QB15 for me this week, a streamer.
#RavensFlock #BroncosCountry

Lamar Jackson is still QB2 rest of season for me, and three straight zeros have his price down.

Trade for him before he practices in full next week; offer a WR2.
#RavensFlock

DeVonta Smith is out Monday after missing all three practices with the hamstring. WR15 rest of season for me.

Pivot to Germie Bernard, WR21 for me this week, a WR2.
#FlyEaglesFly #HereWeGo

Dontayvion Wicks is out with the ankle too, so rookie Makai Lemon starts. Lemon caught 3 for 19 on 6 targets in Week 6.

WR49 for me, a dart throw.
#FlyEaglesFly

Dallas Goedert practiced in full Saturday after missing Thursday and Friday with the knee, and he has no designation for Monday.

TE9 for me this week.
#FlyEaglesFly

Saquon Barkley practiced in full Saturday after two limited days and is questionable for Monday. RB29 for me, a high-end RB3. Monitor the Eagles' inactives at 6:45 PM ET Monday.

Dameon Pierce is RB33 for me, a low-end RB3; keep him as the handcuff.
#FlyEaglesFly

George Pickens is off Dallas' final report after a full practice Friday with the shoulder.

WR17 for me this week, a WR2, and WR12 rest of season.
#DallasCowboys

Minnesota activated Jordan Mason off IR, and he plays Sunday with no designation. RB28 for me, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play.

Aaron Jones Sr. splits the early downs with him now. RB18 for me, a low-end RB2.
#Skol

Denver activated Jonah Coleman off IR after full practices all week. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

J.K. Dobbins loses early downs to him. RB23 for me this week, an RB2.
#BroncosCountry

San Francisco activated Christian Kirk off IR, and he plays at ATL with Mike Evans out. It is his first game of the season.

Add Kirk in 12-team leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Brian Robinson Jr. is out with the hamstring, so Bijan Robinson has the Atlanta backfield to himself Sunday.

Bijan Robinson is RB2 for me this week.
#DirtyBirds

Green Bay put Josh Jacobs on the active roster Saturday, so he debuts at DET.

RB17 for me this week, an RB2, and RB22 rest of season.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Cleveland activated Dylan Sampson off IR after the knee injury from the opener. Monitor his snap share Sunday at TEN.

Quinshon Judkins has no designation. RB40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#DawgPound #TitanUp

Puka Nacua is questionable with the calf after missing Friday's practice. WR3 for me this week. Monitor the Rams' inactives at 2:55 PM ET Sunday.

Tyler Higbee is TE10 for me with Davante Adams out.
#RamsHouse

Breece Hall is questionable with the quad and a game-time call Sunday.

Braelon Allen is RB13 for me if Hall sits, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor the Jets' inactives at 11:30 AM ET Sunday.
#JetUp

Every Saturday note is on the Pass, and Sunday's inactives and pivots start at 11:30 AM ET.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's calls, and repost this for your league before lineups lock.
